title: Drone shot down by Nato over Lithuania

blocks.text: VILNIUS — Nato fighter jets shot down a drone over Lithuania, the Baltic state’s president said Tuesday, in the latest security incident on the alliance’s eastern flank during Russia’s war with Ukraine. Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia — Nato members sharing a long border with Russia — regularly report drone incursions since Moscow launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. “A drone that just entered Lithuanian airspace was destroyed by Nato fighter jets,” Gitanas Nauseda wrote in a post on X. “With Russia intensifying its aggression against Ukraine, such readiness is vital for our region,” he added.
